organizations.normalization_notes: Student relationships are represented separately from employment.

affiliations.date_precision: After Duke graduation in 1940 and until withdrawal in 1943; exact matriculation and withdrawal dates are not established
affiliations.research_notes: Princeton memorial states that he withdrew in 1943 to join the Army and OSS. This supports a pre-service student pathway; the Army assignment between university and OSS is not resolved here. No employer is inferred from enrollment.

claims.claim_text: Lorenz E. A. Eitner was a Princeton Graduate School student before withdrawing in 1943 to join the Army and OSS; Princeton is documented as an institution attended, not an employer.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Princeton graduate memorial names Eitner with matching initials and says he entered its graduate school after Duke and withdrew in 1943 for Army and OSS service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High: the memorial's uncommon full name and three initials match the indexed Lorenz E.A. Eitner, and it independently identifies Army and OSS service. The index records 2nd Lt.; the memorial does not verify the commission or service identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: Princeton study ended in 1943 for wartime service. An Army assignment may have intervened before OSS; therefore the university is not designated the immediate pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: Do not equate enrollment with employment, and do not import later Stanford or Minnesota faculty posts into the pre-OSS timeline.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The unusual full name and E.A. initials in the Box 215 index match Princeton's Lorenz E. A. Eitner; Princeton also explicitly links him to Army and OSS service. The memorial does not identify the Army commission or an employer.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 215 and Army records for the assignment between Princeton and OSS; inspect any contemporary pre-service employment evidence instead of treating Princeton enrollment as employment.

research_attempts.query_text: Lorenz E. A. Eitner Princeton Graduate School 1943 Army OSS employer
research_attempts.research_notes: Princeton memorial provides exact full-name and OSS crosswalk and identifies graduate study before Army/OSS entry. No employer or immediate OSS predecessor is supported by this source. The underlying personnel file and Army sequence need examination.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 215 and Army service records for dates and preceding employer.
